finding_summary: End-gate change-workflow guard (5.RC, conductor/workflow.md ~2753-2762) enumerates git status --porcelain and discards every untracked path not in endgate_item_writable_files via git clean -f -d — with NO RUNTIME-STATE EXCLUSION carve-out, unlike its two sibling sites (AVFL ~1962, E2E ~2348). Untracked .momentum/ runtime state (e.g. the freshly-rendered endgate-report.html, new handoffs/stubs) would be destroyed at the first developer change-request pass.
evidence: conductor/workflow.md:2754 enumerates porcelain paths; :2757-2760 git clean -f -d for untracked paths outside writable set; sibling carve-outs exist at :1962-1966 and :2348-2354 declaring RUNTIME-STATE EXCLUSION mandatory; 5.RC has none. Sibling precedent: the staging-clause decision card (conduct-conductor-staging-and-ledger-append-safety / bmad-code-review-0) covers the same family of silent-file-loss defects and was likewise deliberately held for the gate. Source: avfl-merge-review iteration 1, HIGH confidence.
suggested_fix: Add the same RUNTIME-STATE EXCLUSION to the 5.RC guard: exclude every path under .momentum/ from the discard loop before git clean -f -d. Operational safeguard this session: the Conductor will apply the sibling carve-out manually if any 5.RC pass executes before the fix is ratified.
